countyCountDifferences.explanation: The workbook has one extra source row named ABSENTEE. It is an all-zero administrative placeholder with no separate participation identity and is classified non-geographic.
The workbook exposes 20 polling-place-labeled source rows while the participation report exposes 22 named precinct/local-unit identities. Count proximity is not used to infer a 22-to-20 crosswalk.

boundaryCandidate.bodyVintageClassifier: Exact extracted in-body statement: This map became effective January 15, 2012.
boundaryCandidate.caveat: Only the 38 explicitly dated bodies are classified as election-effective boundary evidence. The other 14 retained PDFs remain vintage-unproven. No retained PDF is normalized GIS delivery, and no feature-named OCG label itself proves a polygon or result key.

caveats: The official 99-county XLS index and all 99 retained workbooks yield 1,687 unique county-qualified President source rows that reconcile exactly by Election Day, Absentee, and Total slices to every workbook county total, the certified 99-county canvass, and statewide totals. One all-zero Dallas ABSENTEE administrative row is non-geographic, leaving 1,686 colorable source rows. The separate participation report retains 1,688 identities; the statewide one-row difference is fully accounted for by Dallas (35 workbook vs 34 participation) and Lee (20 vs 22), without treating count similarity as a crosswalk. Systematic map URL enumeration retained 52 official county PDFs; 38 bodies explicitly state a January 15, 2012 effective date, 14 are vintage-unproven, and 47 URLs redirect to the official unavailable page. The Dubuque archive supplies 35 reviewed geographic code-to-polling-place mappings plus one non-geographic absentee aggregate, but four of 210 compared Election Day candidate cells differ from the SOS workbook and no code is assigned to a polygon.

The workbook field headed Precinct is preserved verbatim. Dallas includes one all-zero non-geographic ABSENTEE placeholder; Lee reports 20 polling-place labels while participation reports 22 precinct/local-unit identities.

Dubuque's reviewed official county archive supplies explicit numeric codes and polling-place labels, but its code 10 Obama/Romney cells and code 41 Goode/Stein cells differ from the reconciled SOS workbook. The cause is unresolved and no misconduct inference is made.
Exact normalized label overlap across source families is reported only as a diagnostic and never adopted as a geometry relationship.
The earlier results-index HTTP 403 artifact is an environment-specific historical observation superseded by successful HTTP 200 acquisition of the index and all 99 workbooks.
Participation total-voted/absentee values are turnout context only and are not presidential contest votes.
The dated 2014 statewide ZIP remains unavailable and is not backcast. No 2015, post-2020, or 2024 geometry or identifier decision is reused.
Delivery remains null; no polygon or candidate vote is assigned to geometry.
